s2.ptxt: Using a plastic hammer, install the 4 straight pins to the rear differential carrier.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Differential Breather Plug Oil Deflector

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 5, install the rear differential breather plug oil deflector with the 2 bolts.

atten3.ptxt: Install it so that the stamped mark faces the front of the vehicle (transmission coupling side).

s2.ptxt: Thoroughly clean off any oil and grease from the differential ring gear contact surface of the rear differential case.
Secure the differential case in a vise between aluminum plates.
Align the matchmarks on the rear differential case and differential ring gear, and install the differential ring gear.

item.ptxt: Clean the threaded holes of the differential case.
Align the bolt holes of the rear differential case with the threaded holes of the differential ring gear.

s2.ptxt: Tighten the 10 new rear differential case bolts.

item.ptxt: New rear differential case bolts are coated with heat-treated film oil, so never wash it off.
Tighten the rear differential case bolts in several passes, in a diagonal sequence.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the rear differential case bearing RH (inner race) onto the rear differential case.

atten3.ptxt: If the rear differential case bearing inner race is damaged, use a new one.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the rear differential case bearing LH (inner race) onto the rear differential case.

atten3.ptxt: If the rear differential case bearing inner race is damaged, use a new one.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the rear differential side gear shaft washer and rear differential case bearing LH (outer race) into the differential side bearing retainer.

item.ptxt: Reinstall the removed rear differential side gear shaft washer.
When replacing a bearing, replace the outer race and inner race as a set.
Install the rear differential side gear shaft oil seal after the tooth contact inspection and backlash adjustment.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the rear differential side gear shaft washer and rear differential case bearing RH (outer race) into the rear differential carrier.

item.ptxt: Reinstall the removed rear differential side gear shaft washer.
When replacing a bearing, replace the outer race and inner race as a set.
Install the rear differential side gear shaft oil seal after the tooth contact inspection and backlash adjustment.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Pinion Tapered Roller Bearing Front

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing FR (outer race) into the rear differential carrier.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Pinion Tapered Roller Bearing Rear

s2.ptxt: Using SST, a bolt, nut and washer, install the rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing RR (outer race) to the rear differential carrier.

atten4.ptxt: Install it using a bolt M12 x P1.25, length under head 186mm (part No. 90101-12159) and a nut M12 x P1.25 (part No. 90179-12051).

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Drive Pinion Tapered Roller Bearing Rear

s2.ptxt: Install the rear differential drive pinion washer to the differential drive pinion.

atten3.ptxt: Reinstall the removed rear differential drive pinion washer.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, press the tapered roller bearing RR (inner race) onto the differential drive pinion.
Install the differential drive pinion (with rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing RR inner race) to the rear differential carrier.
Install the rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing FR (inner race) and a new rear drive pinion nut to the differential drive pinion.

item.ptxt: When using a new bearing, it is coated with anti-rust oil, so never wash it off.
When reusing the bearing, apply hypoid gear oil SX to the bearing.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, tighten the new rear drive pinion nut little by little, within the limit, until the specified preload is reached.
Using SST and a torque wrench, measure the turning torque of the differential drive pinion.

item.ptxt: Turn the bearing forward and backward several times to seat it, then inspect.
Record the preload for the total preload inspection.

s2.ptxt: Install the rear differential case to the rear differential carrier.
Using a scraper, clean off the seal packing adhering to the differential carrier and differential side bearing retainer, then remove any oil with cleaning solvent.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the installation surfaces.

s2.ptxt: Install the differential side bearing retainer to the rear differential carrier with the 8 bolts.
Insert a dial indicator through the rear differential filler plug hole and place it at a right angle against the tip of a ring gear tooth.
Using SST, hold the drive pinion.
Using SST, turn the rear differential case forward and backward and measure the backlash.

atten3.ptxt: Measure at 3 or more locations around the ring gear circumference.

s2.ptxt: If the backlash is not as specified, select a rear differential side gear shaft washer from the table and install it.

item.ptxt: Increase or decrease the thicknesses of the LH and RH rear differential side gear shaft washers by the same amount to bring the backlash within the standard.
If the backlash is small, select a thicker washer for the RH side and a thinner washer for the LH side.
If the backlash is large, select a thinner washer for the RH side, a thinner washer for the LH side, and a thicker washer for the LH side.

table.title: Rear Differential Side Gear Shaft Washer Types

s-1.ptxt: Adjust Differential Ring Gear and Drive Pinion Tooth Contact

s2.ptxt: Remove the 8 bolts and the differential side bearing retainer from the rear differential carrier.
Remove the rear differential case.
Apply a thin, even coat of red lead (Prussian blue) to both sides of the differential ring gear teeth.
Install the rear differential case.
Temporarily install the differential side bearing retainer to the differential carrier with the 8 bolts.
Rotate the differential drive pinion several times.
Remove the 8 bolts and the differential side bearing retainer from the rear differential carrier.
Inspect the tooth contact between the differential drive pinion and differential ring gear.

atten3.ptxt: Check the contact pattern at 2 locations around the circumference of the differential ring gear.

s2.ptxt: If there is face contact or flank contact, perform the following.

s3.ptxt: Adjust by moving the ring gear using the rear differential side gear shaft washers.

atten4.ptxt: Adjust by increasing or decreasing the thicknesses of the LH and RH rear differential side gear shaft washers by the same amount.

s2.ptxt: If there is heel contact or toe contact, perform the following.

s3.ptxt: Select a rear differential drive pinion washer from the table and adjust by moving the drive pinion.

s2.ptxt: If the tooth contact has been adjusted, perform the backlash inspection, preload inspection and tooth contact inspection again.
Using SST and a torque wrench, measure the turning torque with the teeth of the differential drive pinion and differential ring gear in contact.

atten3.ptxt: To seat the case bearings, turn forward and in reverse several times before measuring.

s2.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, perform the following.

s3.ptxt: Reselect and install the RH side gear shaft washer.
Perform the total preload inspection, backlash inspection and tooth contact inspection again.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 8 bolts and the differential side bearing retainer from the rear differential carrier.
Remove the rear differential case from the rear differential carrier.
Remove the differential drive pinion from the rear differential carrier.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Differential Drive Pinion Bearing Spacer

s2.ptxt: Install a new rear differential drive pinion bearing spacer to the differential drive pinion.
Install the differential drive pinion to the rear differential carrier.
Apply hypoid gear oil LSD to the threads of a new rear drive pinion nut.
Using SST, tighten the rear drive pinion nut while checking the specified preload.
Using SST and a torque wrench, inspect the turning torque.

item.ptxt: Turn the bearing forward and backward several times to seat it, then adjust.
Match the turning torque obtained during the temporary drive pinion adjustment.

s2.ptxt: If the preload is insufficient, using SST, retighten the rear drive pinion nut 5 to 10° at a time, measure the turning torque, and repeat the adjustment until it is within the standard.

If the preload is still insufficient after the rear drive pinion nut tightening torque exceeds 245N*m{2500kgf*cm}, loosen the rear drive pinion nut once and check the threads of the rear drive pinion nut and differential drive pinion for damage.
If there is no problem, replace the rear differential drive pinion bearing spacer, apply hypoid gear oil LSD to the threads, then repeat the procedure above.
Install the rear differential case to the rear differential carrier.
Install the differential side bearing retainer to the rear differential carrier with the 8 bolts.
Insert a dial indicator through the rear differential carrier cover plug hole, and place it at a right angle to the tip of the ring gear tooth surface.
Using SST, hold the drive pinion.
Using SST, turn the rear differential case forward and in reverse to check the backlash.

atten3.ptxt: Inspect at 3 or more locations around the circumference of the ring gear.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a torque wrench, measure the turning torque with the teeth of the differential drive pinion and differential ring gear in contact.

atten3.ptxt: To seat the case bearings, turn forward and in reverse several times before measuring.

s2.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, perform the following.

s3.ptxt: Reselect and install the RH side gear shaft washer.
Perform the backlash inspection and total preload inspection again.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 8 bolts and the side bearing retainer from the rear differential carrier.
Apply seal packing 1281 to the differential side bearing retainer at the positions shown in the illustration.

item.ptxt: Apply seal packing 1281 in a continuous bead with a diameter of 2 to 3mm.
Install within 3 minutes after applying seal packing 1281.

s2.ptxt: Install the differential side bearing retainer to the rear differential carrier with the 8 bolts.

atten3.ptxt: After installing the cover, do not fill with oil or drive the vehicle for at least 1 hours. Also, avoid sudden acceleration and deceleration for at least 12 hours after that.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a torque wrench, inspect the turning torque with the teeth of the differential drive pinion and differential ring gear in contact.

atten3.ptxt: Turn the case bearing forward and backward several times to seat it, then inspect.

s2.ptxt: Insert a dial indicator through the rear differential carrier cover plug hole, and place it at a right angle to the tip of the ring gear tooth surface.
Using SST, hold the drive pinion.
Using SST, turn the rear differential case forward and in reverse to check the backlash.

atten3.ptxt: Inspect at 3 or more locations around the circumference of the ring gear.

s2.ptxt: Using a chisel and hammer, stake the rear drive pinion nut.
Using SST and a hammer, tap a new diaphragm oil seal into the rear differential carrier to the standard depth.

item.ptxt: Tap the oil seal in evenly so that it goes in straight.
Do not tap the oil seal in too far.

s2.ptxt: Apply a light coat of MP grease No.2 to the oil seal lip.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Differential Side Gear Shaft Oil Seal

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a hammer, tap the 2 new rear differential side gear shaft oil seals into the differential carrier to the standard depth

item.ptxt: Tap the oil seal in evenly so that it goes in straight.
Do not tap the oil seal in too far.

s2.ptxt: Apply a light coat of MP grease No.2 to the oil seal lip.
Using vernier calipers and a straightedge, measure dimension B1 and dimension B2 of the transmission coupling.
Calculate dimension B from the difference between dimension B1 and dimension B2.

atten4.ptxt: Dimension B (bearing shaft distance) = dimension B1 - dimension B2

s2.ptxt: Using vernier calipers and a straightedge, measure dimension A of the differential carrier.

atten4.ptxt: Dimension A: drive pinion shaft distance

s2.ptxt: Select a transmission coupling shim based on the difference between dimension A and dimension B, and install it.

s-1.ptxt: Install Transmission Coupling Conical Spring Washer

s2.ptxt: Install the transmission coupling conical spring washer to the rear differential carrier.

atten3.ptxt: Install the transmission coupling conical spring washer with the green marking or convex side facing the front of the vehicle (coupling side).

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 5, install the yoke to the differential carrier assembly with the 3 bolts.
Install a new O-ring to the solenoid.
Install the solenoid to the yoke.
Using SST, install a new snap ring.
Using a scraper, clean off the seal packing adhering to the rear differential carrier and transmission coupling assembly, then remove oil with cleaning solvent or equivalent.
Apply seal packing 1281 to the area of the transmission coupling assembly shown in the illustration.

item.ptxt: Apply the seal packing in a continuous bead with a diameter of 2 to 3mm.
Overlap the start and end of the seal packing bead by 10mm or more.
Install within 3 minutes after applying the seal packing.

s2.ptxt: Install the rear differential carrier cover to the rear differential carrier assembly with the 4 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Differential Carrier Cover Breather Plug

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a plastic hammer, tap a new rear differential carrier cover breather plug into the differential carrier until it contacts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Differential Carrier Cover Plug

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 8, install a new rear differential carrier cover plug to the differential carrier.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 10, install the rear differential filler plug with a new gasket.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 10, install the rear differential drain plug with a new gasket.
Install a dial indicator with a lever-type probe at a right angle to the inner circumferential surface of the transmission coupling assembly.
Using SST, turn the transmission coupling assembly forward and in reverse to measure its vertical runout.
Install a dial indicator at a right angle to the transmission coupling assembly at the position shown in the illustration.
Using SST, turn the transmission coupling assembly forward and in reverse to measure its lateral runout.
Install the 4 stud bolts to the transmission coupling assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Install them with the longer threaded end on the transmission coupling assembly side.
